## What is PrairieLearn?

PrairieLearn is an online learning and assessment platform used for practice, homework, quizzes, and exams.

- Main site: <https://www.prairielearn.org/>
- Documentation: <https://prairielearn.readthedocs.io/>

## What is PrairieTest?

PrairieTest is the testing workflow used to deliver and support exams built from PrairieLearn content.

- PrairieTest site: <https://www.prairietest.org/>
